readerCopy.body: A sensitive subject can become easier to explain when the difference between what happened and what it came to mean is clearer. When Mercury trines Chiron, communication and sensitivity reinforce each other, making a direct question, carefully written message, or useful detail capable of clearing more than another long replay of the history. The conversation can stay focused on what still matters now. Better language does not erase the hurt; it gives the present something more precise to work with.
